annotation.title_clean: Part 1192—Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accessibility Guidelines for Transportation Vehicles
annotation.title_en: Part 1192—Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accessibility Guidelines for Transportation Vehicles
annotation.authors_or_issuer: U.S. Architectural and Transportation Barriers Compliance Board (Access Board)
annotation.venue: Code of Federal Regulations (36 CFR Part 1192)
annotation.summary_en: US federal regulation setting minimum ADA accessibility guidelines for transportation vehicles (buses, vans, rapid, light, commuter and intercity rail, other systems) used by DOT in 49 CFR part 37. It specifies dimensions, lifts, ramps, signage and announcements. Automated guideway transit is mentioned only incidentally; no AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets minimum accessibility design requirements for buses, vans, and rail vehicles under the ADA.
Specifies lift, ramp, doorway, wheelchair space and securement dimensions and loads.
Requires platform-vehicle gap and height coordination for level boarding.
Allows equivalent facilitation by DOT case-by-case.
Automated guideway transit vehicles must meet rapid rail accessibility provisions.
